commands.name: desk-search
commands.summary: Use when you cannot tell which file holds something, or what changed in a time window. Exact-word search across the desk. Filters: track, status, kind, since, until. `scope`: 'active' (default), 'archived' or 'all'. With no `query`, or `newest: true`, it lists documents by when they were updated, newest first, inside the since/until window (`scope` then defaults to 'all').

query.description: The search query. Omit it to list documents by update time.

newest.description: Pass true to order by update time, newest first, instead of by match.

scope.description: Which documents to search: live work, archived work, or both.

filters.description: Filters, as a JSON object (not a string), as JSON.

commands.name: desk-recall
commands.summary: Use for loose recall, as in `do I remember anything about X`. Ranks every desk Markdown file by meaning and exact words together. `scope`: 'active', 'archived' or 'all' (default; this is the historical lookback).

scope.description: Which documents to search: live work, archived work, or both.

commands.name: desk-skill
commands.summary: Use when your client cannot load Desk's skills itself (claude.ai, ChatGPT): read one of Desk's skills, the working procedures its instructions point to. With no `name`, lists every skill with its description; with `name`, returns that skill's text to follow. Read-only and needs no desk.

name.description: The skill to read, such as task-lifecycle; omit it to list every skill.

commands.name: desk-status
commands.summary: Session-start health check for the resolved desk root. The compact answer has `state` (ready, degraded, admitting or setup_required), `degraded` (why), `fix` (what to do in this session), `search`, `notes`, where the desk is and `machine_desks` (every desk registered on this machine, with path, owner and remote). Retries admission when Desk is not ready. `detail: true` returns the full payload. A hosted Desk (claude.ai, ChatGPT) also returns its instructions, unless `has_instructions: true`; follow them and read the skills they name with desk_skill.

detail.description: Pass true for the full payload (tens of KB). Omit it for the compact answer.

desk.description: Name, repo or owner of another desk on this machine (for example personal): the answer's `machine_desk` has its local path, or says what to do when it is not here. Never clone a registered desk.

has-instructions.description: Hosted Desk only: pass true when an earlier desk_status answer in this conversation already gave you Desk's instructions.

commands.name: desk-doctor
commands.summary: Use when Desk misbehaves or its runtime needs checking: report whether Desk MCP started in healthy runtime mode; in diagnostic mode, the precise startup failure and offline remediation. `format: "preview"` returns only the local package/process snapshot. `repair: "switch_state_branch"` switches the desk checkout back to its state branch when that is safe. `reindex: true` re-reads the desk into the search engine when search misses what you just wrote. `factory_consent` records the operator's factory contribution answer and returns only that record.

format.description: preview returns only the local package/process snapshot.

reindex.description: Pass true to re-read the desk into this session's search engine and wait until exact-word search is current.

factory-consent.description: The operator's answer to the factory contribution question; Desk resolves the store and, for yes, the GitHub account.

commands.name: improvement-next
commands.summary: Use when you take on improvement work: take the next improvement card, the open card that waited longest. It claims the card for a limited time and returns it with the `claim_id` and the authority statement. A refusal comes back as `status` (claim_held, none_open, too_many_cards, machine_key_unavailable or noninteractive) with a one-line `meaning`. Optional `session` is the session's UUID.
